column1: # Source-owned direct behavior tests for txnkv-iteration-source-wave.
# The upstream pkg/kv package has no TestNextUntil or TestWalkMemBuffer anchor;
# the dedicated Rust artifact therefore attaches to the source test file as a
# partial file-level obligation rather than to an unrelated Go test function.

column8: The dedicated Rust artifact covers stop-on-match iterator creation and advance errors callback errors empty iteration all-entry walking and deferred close behavior for pkg/kv/{iter,utils}.go while the original four anchored tests remain owned by their existing waves.
